metaDescription: Brand identity and creative direction for businesses on Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao — original visual systems carried through every channel.
directAnswer: CreativeLAB builds brand identities for businesses across Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao — strategy, visual identity and creative direction developed as one coherent system, then applied consistently through our own web, social, photography and advertising work rather than handed over as a static PDF.
heroSupport: Brand identity and creative direction that actually gets used — across your website, social media, menus and signage.
heroImageAlt: Brand identity materials laid out for review in a design studio
overview: Most island businesses we meet have a logo but not a brand — a mark that was designed once and then applied inconsistently across a website built by one freelancer, social templates made by another, and signage ordered from a local printer with none of them talking to each other. The result is a business that looks less established than it actually is.

We treat branding as the foundation everything else gets built on, not a separate deliverable. Because CreativeLAB also produces the photography, video, websites and advertising that carry a brand day to day, an identity we design doesn't sit still — it gets tested and refined the moment it's applied to real work, across whichever of the three islands your business operates on.

This page introduces branding as part of that wider creative practice — what it covers and who it's for. For the detailed scope, process and pricing of a branding project, see our Branding & Creative service page, which is the canonical version of this content.

Businesses that operate across more than one of the three islands — a villa group with properties on Phangan and Samui, for instance, or a wellness brand expanding from one island to another — particularly benefit from a defined identity system, since it's what keeps the business recognizable as it grows rather than looking like several unrelated ventures.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses on Koh Samui and Koh Tao, not just Koh Phangan?
faqs.a: Yes — CreativeLAB is based on Koh Phangan and builds brand identities for businesses across all three islands.

faqs.q: How is this different from the Branding page under Branding & Creative?
faqs.a: This page introduces branding as part of our wider creative practice across the three islands; the Branding & Creative hub page is the full service with detailed scope, process and pricing.

faqs.q: Do you only design logos, or full brand identities?
faqs.a: Full brand identities — strategy, visual system and applications, not just a logo mark.

faqs.q: Can you apply our brand to our website and social media too?
faqs.a: Yes — our web, social and video services are built to carry the brand system through consistently once it's designed.

faqs.q: How long does a brand identity project take?
faqs.a: Typically 4–8 weeks depending on scope and how many touchpoints are included.

faqs.q: Can you refresh an existing brand rather than starting from scratch?
faqs.a: Yes — we regularly refine and modernize existing identities rather than replacing them entirely.

faqs.q: Do you handle a brand that needs to work across more than one of the islands?
faqs.a: Yes — we design with that flexibility in mind when a business already operates or plans to operate on more than one island.
